title: Muon Space, which is building a spacecraft platform for orbital data centers and AI computing, raised a $250M Series C, with participation from Google (Yash Roy/Bloomberg)
summary: Yash Roy / Bloomberg: Muon Space, which is building a spacecraft platform for orbital data centers and AI computing, raised a $250M Series C, with participation from Google — Satellite startup Muon Space Inc. closed a $250 million funding round, raising capital from Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Salesforce Ventures LLC …
